title: Sita Ramam
desc: Upon returning to Pakistan, Afreen sets off to fulfil her grandfather's wish of delivering a letter from Ram to Sita. Along the way, she finds Ram and learns about their love story.

title: Lakshmi Mahalakshmi
desc: Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.

title: Jaguar
desc: Krishna, an orphan medical student, lives a seemingly ordinary life. However, unbeknownst to people, he is a vigilante named Jaguar who pursues a certain group of people in order to kill them.

title: Vaalee
desc: Deva falls obsessively in love with his twin brother's wife and stops at nothing to separate the two in order to win her.

title: Ondagona Baa
desc: Raghu comes to his paternal village to attend his grandfather's diamond jubilee function. He finds out that due to his uncle, his family was separated, and tries to fix things.
